observations.behavior: Snapshot file P1.F31.H1: added a new property full_refresh_interval_days with range 1-90 days and null, including documentation about wiping the table and re-importing rows.
observations.code_quote: "description": "Days between scheduled full refreshes, from 1 to 90, or null for none. A full refresh wipes the table and re-imports every row, so rows deleted at the source are removed. It runs on the first scheduled sync once the interval has passed, counted from when it was saved or from the last full resync, and can start up to an hour early. Queries keep returning the current rows until a full refresh finishes, and workflows and destinations that run on new rows of the table run again for every row. Available for incremental, append, and xmin syncs only, and never shorter than the sync frequency."
observations.posthog_connection: This adds a configuration option for scheduling full refreshes, which could allow users to control how often a warehouse table is completely re-imported. This could help with data consistency or cleanup, but without implementation, it is not demonstrated.
